tasks.title: Assistant fragment 去重与调用关联
tasks.prompt:
修改事件规范化和 trace 分析，使同一 SDK assistant message ID 的 thinking、text、tool-use fragments 关联同一 callId，usage 不重复求和。保留 block 顺序，并增加重复 usage 与 output=0 测试。

Modify event normalization and trace analysis so thinking, text, and tool-use fragments that share the same SDK assistant message ID map to one callId without double-counting usage. Preserve block order and add tests for duplicate usage and output=0.
tasks.firstUsefulPredicate: 首次修改允许模块且该修改保留在最终通过 diff / First edit to an allowed module that remains in the final passing diff
acceptanceCriteria: 同 message ID 多 fragment 只有一个 call usage
block 不丢（三个 fragment → blocks=3）

Record compact_boundary, hook_response, status, and unknown SDK blocks; unknown content must be redacted and downloadable, never silently dropped.
tasks.firstUsefulPredicate: 第一个新增事件类型通过测试 / First newly added event type passes its test
acceptanceCriteria: 未知内容经脱敏且可下载

tasks.title: 逐调用 Context Ledger 与 95% gate
tasks.prompt:
实现纯函数 Context Ledger，输入 captured request、count-tokens 与 provider usage，输出固定类别、占比、coverage、residual 和 measurement；低于 95% 警告。

Implement a pure-function Context Ledger that takes a captured request, count-tokens results, and provider usage and emits fixed categories, shares, coverage, residual, and measurement; warn below 95% coverage.
tasks.firstUsefulPredicate: fixture 首次 coverage >=0.95 / First fixture coverage >= 0.95

tasks.firstUsefulPredicate: 第一个 pricing test 通过 / First pricing test passes

tasks.title: 完整 Tool Error Artifact 与安全 Replay
tasks.prompt:

UI truncates long output today. Implement full redacted artifact storage plus a safe out-of-agent Read replay with ground-truth diff.

acceptanceCriteria: 64KB+ error 可按 hash 取回
replay 不修改用户工作树

tasks.prompt:

Compare designed vs proxy-sent transcripts and detect missing, unexpected, reordered, truncated, wrong-parent, and wrong-tool-result-pair diffs.

acceptanceCriteria: 六类隐藏 fixture 全识别
DiffKind 含 missing 与 wrong-parent

tasks.title: Resume 多轮上下文完整性
tasks.prompt:
新增集成测试：两轮对话、工具读取、后端重启、SDK Resume、第三轮依赖第一轮工具结果；验证恢复后真实 request parent chain。

Add an integration test for two-turn chat, tool reads, backend restart, SDK Resume, and a third turn that depends on first-turn tool results; verify the restored request parent chain.
tasks.firstUsefulPredicate: Resume 后捕获第一条正确关联 request / First correctly linked request captured after Resume
acceptanceCriteria: 关键事实或合法 summary 存在

tasks.title: Permission/Stop/Timeout 失败证据链

tasks.firstUsefulPredicate: 首个 terminal permission 与 request 正确配对 / First terminal permission correctly paired with its request
acceptanceCriteria: 完成 run 不回到 waiting

tasks.title: 冻结 Task Spec 与 Repository Verifier
tasks.prompt:
